name: (04) Protean — 3 Advanced — Restore the Mortal Visage

system.description:
You shed the bestial marks the centuries have graven upon you, restoring the mortal face you wore before the Embrace.

Spend two Blood Traits and a Willpower Trait, then win a Static Mental Challenge. On success, every animal characteristic you have accumulated vanishes completely for the duration of the scene, along with any Negative Social Traits they caused. Only Gangrel have ever safely displayed this power; whispered rumors hold that Nosferatu elders who attempted to resume a mortal form met swift and horrible Final Death.
system.bloodCost: Two Blood Traits plus One Willpower Trait
